command_template: python3 tools/debian_native_container_probe.py CLIENT VERIFIED_DEB DEB_SHA256 VERIFIED_SKILL_ZIP SKILL_SHA256 --fixture-mode MODE --container-memory-mib 128 --sample-server-resources
fixture: Route-free DNS/HTTP. Slow mode sends /plain, /drip, /delayed, /plain; body mode sends /plain, /large, /chunked-large, /plain.
limitations: The server monitor samples /proc about every 50 ms using pidof/find/awk; transient FD or RSS peaks can be missed. It is not a hard resource bound.
The Debian container has a 128 MiB memory/swap limit and 64 PID limit. Container cgroup high-water marks include package setup and helper processes; sampled server readings are separate.
Sequential finite calls do not prove aggregate concurrency or adversarial cancellation resource bounds. No Cursor or automatic skill triggering.
Native clients ran on Ubuntu while the server ran in Debian 12 amd64. Traffic through other tools is outside Outbound Guard. The package is experimental, not an approved official candidate.

container_resource_observation.scope: Container cgroup high-water marks include setup and helper processes; not server-only RSS or FD peaks.

server_resource_observation.scope: Finite sampled server observations; sampling can miss transient peaks.
